# 汪连 ArchieLink

> 跨平台网络体检与外网连接恢复 CLI（macOS/Windows/Linux）：先体检、再经 Cloudflare WARP/WireGuard 安全连接，失败自动回滚。内置 Claude Code/Codex 可安装的 Agent 技能与鸿蒙/Android 伴生应用。source-available；付费解锁一键连接与完整导出。
>
> ArchieLink is a cross-platform CLI that runs a read-only network health check, then establishes foreign-network connectivity via Cloudflare WARP / WireGuard with snapshot, coexistence gate, health verification and deterministic auto-rollback. Ships installable agent skills and HarmonyOS / Android companions. Source-available; paid activation unlocks one-command connect and full config export.

## 安装

- [README「安装」节](README.md#安装): 四平台二进制、SHA256SUMS 校验、Gatekeeper/SmartScreen 指引
- [Releases v1.1.0](https://github.com/nocaptain-oss/archie-link/releases): 二进制 + `SHA256SUMS` + `release-manifest.json` + `sbom.cdx.json`
- AI Agent 技能：`npx skills add nocaptain-oss/archie-link@archie-link`（或 `cp -R`，见 README）

## Agent 技能

- [archie-link 技能](skills/archie-link/SKILL.md): 体检 → 连接 → 回滚全流程；中文触发场景：外网访问、科学上网、翻墙、GFW、VPN 连不上等
- [archie-link-doctor 技能](skills/archie-link-doctor/SKILL.md): 只读网络诊断（不改系统设置）；中文触发场景：网络体检、网络诊断、VPN 排查等
